tiktok.caption: You think a tax refund is winning. It's not. It means you overpaid all year — and the IRS paid you 0% interest on your own money. Here's the 5-minute fix.

youtube_short.title: 73% of Workers Give the IRS a Free $2,753 Loan
title_alternatives: Your Tax Refund Is Proof You Overpaid All Year
youtube_short.description: Getting a tax refund feels great — but it's actually proof that you overpaid your taxes all year and gave the IRS an interest-free loan. 73% of workers over-withhold, handing the government an average of $2,753 with zero interest paid back. The fix takes 5 minutes: update your W-4 through the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and submit it to HR. Your next paycheck gets bigger — permanently. #personalfinance #taxes #moneytips #financetips #w4 — Drop a comment if this changed how you think about refunds!

hook_line: Your tax refund = a 0% loan you gave the IRS
